summary: Plan e-invoice integration, data controls, and reconciliation with practical implementation exercises. Explore the course and assess fit for your team.
lede: E-invoicing and digital tax administration training helps tax administrators, finance teams, and ERP leads plan structured invoice exchange and dependable tax-data workflows. Participants practise mapping UBL 2.1 and UN/CEFACT Cross Industry Invoice data to ERP processes, validating submissions, handling exceptions, and reconciling invoice records. They also explore access controls, audit trails, and AI-assisted anomaly detection at an operational-awareness level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, operate, or assure electronic invoicing and digital tax processes across public-sector and corporate environments.
prerequisites: Prior experience in tax administration, accounting, finance operations, ERP delivery, or digital-service implementation is recommended. No programming is required. Exercises focus on process maps, structured invoice examples, and implementation decisions; advanced AI and interoperability topics receive operational-awareness coverage rather than technical engineering instruction.
